title: Add a note creation form
body:
Add a browser interface for creating notes with the existing API.

- R1: Show a note form with required title and comma-separated tags fields.
- R2: Split and trim tags, preserving Unicode, and submit title plus tags to POST /api/notes.
- R3: Show the returned note in the notes list without requiring a reload; reject an empty title. Add repository browser E2E tests.
